subject: Request: extracting svalues and the list of loglikelihood values from output

messages.author: 782963d0085f5712
messages.subject: Request: extracting svalues and the list of loglikelihood values from output
parts:
Hello,

I am writing to request a feature that would allow the extraction of svalues from the output for models that include OUTPUT: SVALUES, as well as the table of final stage loglikelihood values.

Thank you very much for considering this request.

Dina

messages.author: 782963d0085f5712
messages.subject: Re: Request: extracting svalues and the list of loglikelihood values from output
parts:
Hello, 

I wanted to kindly follow up on the feature request. It would be incredibly useful to have a way to extract error messages shown just before the "MODEL FIT INFORMATION" section, as well as those in TECH11 and TECH14 outputs. This addition would be very helpful for quickly identifying issues in the modeling process, as it is easy to overlook these during the automation of the models. 

Thank you again for your time.

Hi Dina,

I'm not sure how @Michael would want to handle this kind of requests but, while there is no response from him, shall I recommend that you open an issue for your request?

I think that would be helpful to discuss the feature you are requesting and provide more precise info on it.  Also, it would be great if you could attach to the issue a sample output that could be used to test this feature.

I hope that helps.

Best,
Daniel
